policy.rollover_method: Sort selections by kickoff, fixture ID and player ID; partition into consecutive non-overlapping blocks of the stated length. Start each block with $10 and roll the entire return through every leg. Any loss returns $0. Ignore and count an incomplete final block.
policy.same_kickoff_warning: The deterministic ordering can put simultaneous selections in one block, so rollover output is a mathematical selection-order simulation, not a claim that every block was executable live.

method_correction.reason: User clarified that rollover means one continuous all-in balance: $10 multiplied by odds for every consecutive win, with the entire accumulated balance lost on the next miss.
method_correction.restart_policy: For season-wide reporting, a new $10 is deposited after each loss to show the next independent streak. Without a new deposit, the first loss ends the simulation at $0.
method_correction.status: post-result accounting clarification; selection rules, odds, picks and outcomes unchanged
method_correction.warning: No profit is realized unless the bettor cashes out. Rolling the full balance into a losing next selection makes that streak's ending balance $0.
